accounting_protocol: per-stratum Poisson sampled Gaussian; no client-subsampling amplification credited
baseline_protocol: At each active local step, each mutually exclusive stratum is Poisson-sampled at q_uniform, its clipped gradients are summed, one independent Gaussian vector is added for that stratum (including empty samples), and the privatized stratum sums are combined.
not_exact_reproduction: This is an explicit, record-level-accountable stratum-specific Gaussian comparator. The source paper names an individualized-DP-SGD-style baseline but does not prescribe a unique noise-placement implementation.
privacy_claim_readiness: accountant validation and secure-randomness prerequisites passed; independent end-to-end mechanism, adjacency, transcript, and implementation review remains required
